Optional: place hls.min.js here (from https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js/releases, version 1.5.17 or newer)
to serve the video library from your own server. If this file exists, the plugin uses it and never contacts a CDN.
If it is missing and "Load hls.js from jsDelivr" is ticked in Settings, the plugin loads it from jsDelivr instead.
Safari and iOS play the video streams natively and do not need hls.js.
